entities.summary: Gonzalo, a notable figure in the history of Bolivia, associated with Water War, Gas War, and the Rise of Evo Morales (2000–2005). Preceded by Cochabamba Water War reverses water privatization — April 2000. Their legacy influenced Gas War — President Sánchez de Lozada resigns and flees — October 2003 and Evo Morales inaugurated as first indigenous president — January 22, 2006.
